extraction.notes: No official summer 2027 information found. The current camps page names both 2026 summer programs but no longer includes their summer dates, ages, hours or prices. The official April 17, 2026 summer article confirms two age groups for each program without specifying their ranges. Search found 2023 and 2024 parent handbooks, but their year-specific details were not carried forward. The January 7, 2026 article mentions a summer early-bird discount through February 15 but does not state a registration opening date.

special_needs.text: Kolo Bike Camp and Adventure Camp are not therapeutic programs and are not appropriate choices for youth dealing with behavioral, motivational, or rehabilitation issues. If you are unsure if your camper would be suited for our camps, please reach out to our Camp Director (camps@adventurecenterofasheville.com) and we would be happy to talk more about our program and what we can offer.
